description: This file defines the MaintenanceService class which manages maintenance logs, alerts, and work orders in a manufacturing equipment monitoring system. It includes methods for creating logs, evaluating thresholds, generating alerts, emitting real-time notifications via Socket.IO, listing alerts, and creating work orders from alerts.

classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: A service class for handling maintenance logs, alerts, and work orders, including threshold evaluation and real-time alert notifications.

methods.name: createLogAndEvaluate
methods.description: Creates a maintenance log, evaluates thresholds, generates alerts if thresholds are exceeded, and emits real-time notifications.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of alerts with optional pagination.

methods.name: createWorkOrderFromAlert
methods.description: Creates a work order based on an existing alert, with optional custom title and description.
